predeclared_limits: Only executed receipt-backed actions have actual outcomes.
Three-tick predictions for unexecuted actions are inference, not counterfactual labels.
Candidate H3 evaluation uses separately declared independent evaluation episodes from queue-recovery-v1.
Continuous-world monitoring and recovery samples share one episode identifier but use disjoint runs/receipts and ordered tick ranges.
The fixed deterministic schedule is an owned fixture, not evidence of generalization to stochastic or real environments.
This protocol measures capability and cost, not a learned-policy reward advantage.
